name: rescale
description: Rescale connects ChatGPT to your Rescale cloud high-performance computing account. Find and inspect simulation jobs, runs, logs, and output files; look up available software and hardware; set up, submit, stop, suspend, and resume jobs and workflows; manage files, tags, comments, storage devices, and budgets; review billing, credits, and deposits; and search documents indexed from your workspace's connected data sources. Every action runs with your own Rescale permissions after you sign in with your Rescale account.

interface.longDescription:
Rescale connects ChatGPT to your Rescale cloud high-performance computing account. Find and inspect simulation jobs, runs, logs, and output files; look up available software and hardware; set up, submit, stop, suspend, and resume jobs and workflows; manage files, tags, comments, storage devices, and budgets; review billing, credits, and deposits; and search documents indexed from your workspace's connected data sources. Every action runs with your own Rescale permissions after you sign in with your Rescale account.

Rescale is for engineers and researchers who run simulations on Rescale. It requires an existing account on platform.rescale.com. Submitting or resuming jobs and starting storage devices use your account's credits. Job analytics requires Rescale Data Intelligence, and document search requires a data source connected to your workspace. Files larger than 5 GB can't be read or downloaded through ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Show my most recent jobs and flag any that failed.
Check the log of my last failed job and suggest the likely cause and a fix.
Which simulation software and hardware core types can I use for a CFD run?

positive.description: List the user's recent jobs and their status.
positive.prompt: Show my 5 most recent Rescale jobs with their status and software.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to five of the account's most recent jobs with name, ID, status, and software, or says the account has no jobs yet.

positive.description: Inspect a completed job's output files and log.
positive.prompt: For my most recent completed Rescale job, list its output files and summarize what the job log says.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the latest completed job, lists its output files with names and sizes, and summarizes the key status and log entries without changing the job.

positive.description: Look up available hardware and software before setting up a simulation.
positive.prompt: What software packages can I run on Rescale, and which hardware core types are available?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes available software packages and hardware core types with key specifications, without creating or launching anything.

positive.description: Upload a small text file and tag it.
positive.prompt: Create a text file named chatgpt-review.txt in my Rescale files containing 'Rescale ChatGPT review', then tag it chatgpt-review.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the file, adds the chatgpt-review tag, and confirms the file name and tag.

positive.description: Create and then delete a temporary file, confirming before deleting.
positive.prompt: Create a text file named chatgpt-delete-test.txt in my Rescale files containing 'temporary file', then delete it.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the file, asks the user to confirm the deletion, deletes the file, and confirms it was deleted.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general simulation theory questions that need no account data.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between RANS and LES turbulence models.

negative.description: Do not trigger for jobs on a non-Rescale cluster.
negative.prompt: Check the status of SLURM job 48213 on my university's HPC cluster.

negative.description: Do not trigger for managing the user's own cloud provider account.
negative.prompt: Launch a c7i.4xlarge EC2 instance in my AWS account in us-east-1.

publication.release_notes:
Initial release of the Rescale plugin:
- Review your jobs, status, output files, and logs
- Browse available simulation software and hardware core types
- Upload, tag, and manage files in your Rescale account
- Create and manage jobs

Sign in with your Rescale account. Available for accounts on platform.rescale.com.
